summary: 10 TCs reviewed; 0 real defects. get_access_token raises ProviderNotLinked when account row OR token row missing (lines 55-61, defensive double-check). refresh_google_token uses with_for_update() to serialise concurrent refreshes for same account (line 85). Returns ProviderReauthRequired when refresh_token absent (line 87) OR Google returns 400/401 (lines 105-107). Persists rotated refresh_token if Google sends a new one (lines 122-123). required_env raises for missing OAuth client config (line 91-92). Module docstring documents GitHub bypass (no refresh tokens, Phase C).
